description: Get the linked account's current SmartSite so you can see it BEFORE editing: name, bio, appearance (background/theme), the links already on it (icons, buttons, info bars, with their item ids for removal), product tiles, and a viewUrl to preview it. ALWAYS call this before adding or changing things so edits stay additive.
name: swop_get_my_smartsite
title: See my SmartSite
